Append-only Kanban events for this Quest
protocol.recordRule: Every architecture decision, audit result, migration action, blocker, verification, and publication-readiness claim is appended as an event. Do not rewrite event history.
protocol.safeActionPolicy: Plan and scaffold first. Do not move large assets, delete source folders, publish remotes, rewrite git history, or expose secrets without explicit human approval.
